dn14:0.1: suttantapiṭake dīghanikāyo (dutiyo bhāgo) mahāvaggo namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammā sambuddhassa
dn14:1.1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme karerikuṭikāyaṃ.
dn14:1.1.3: atha kho sambahulānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantānaṃ karerimaṇḍalamāḷe sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ pubbenivāsapaṭisaṃyuttā dhammī kathā udapādi:
dn14:1.2.1: assosi kho bhagavā dibbāya sotadhātuyā visuddhāya atikkanta mānusikāya tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ imaṃ kathāsallāpaṃ.
dn14:1.2.2: atha kho bhagavā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena karerimaṇḍalamāḷo tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi. nisajja kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi:
dn14:1.2.3: “kāyanu’ttha bhikkhave etarahi kathāya sannisinnā? kā ca pana vo antarākathā vippakatā?”ti.
dn14:1.2.4: evaṃ vutte te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
dn14:1.2.5: “idha bhante, amhākaṃ pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantānaṃ karerimaṇḍalamāḷe sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ pubbenivāsapaṭisaṃyuttā dhammī kathā udapādi:
dn14:1.2.7: ayaṃ kho no bhante antarā kathā vippakatā. atha bhagavā anuppatto”ti.
dn14:1.3.1: “iccheyyātha no tumhe bhikkhave pubbenivāsapaṭisaṃyuttaṃ dhammiṃ kathaṃ sotu”nti?
dn14:1.3.3: yaṃ bhagavā pubbenivāsapaṭisaṃyuttaṃ dhammiṃ kathaṃ kareyya. bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantī”ti.
dn14:1.3.4: “tena hi bhikkhave suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī”ti.
dn14:1.4.1: ito so bhikkhave, ekanavutokappo yaṃ vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke udapādi.
dn14:1.4.2: ito so bhikkhave, ekatiṃsokappo yaṃ sikhī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke udapādi.
dn14:1.4.3: tasmiññeva kho bhikkhave ekatiṃse kappe vessabhū bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke udapādi.
dn14:1.4.4: imasmiññeva kho bhikkhave, bhaddakappe kakusandho bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke udapādi.
dn14:1.4.5: imasmiññeva kho bhikkhave, bhaddakappe koṇāgamano bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke udapādi.
dn14:1.4.6: imasmiññeva kho bhikkhave bhaddakappe kassapo bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke udapādi.
dn14:1.4.7: imasmiññeva kho bhikkhave, bhaddakappe ahaṃ etarahi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke uppanno.
dn14:1.5.1: vipassī bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho khattiyo jātiyā ahosi, khattiyakule udapādi.
dn14:1.5.2: sikhī bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho khattiyo jātiyā ahosi, khattiyakule udapādi.
dn14:1.5.3: vessabhū bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho khattiyo jātiyā ahosi, khattiyakule udapādi.
dn14:1.5.4: kakusandho bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho brāhmaṇo jātiyā ahosi, brāhmaṇakule udapādi.
dn14:1.5.5: koṇāgamano bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho brāhmaṇo jātiyā ahosi, brāhmaṇakule udapādi.
dn14:1.5.6: kassapo bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho brāhmaṇo jātiyā ahosi, brāhmaṇakule udapādi.
dn14:1.5.7: ahaṃ bhikkhave, etarahi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho khattiyo jātiyā ahosiṃ, khattiyakule uppanno.
dn14:1.6.1: vipassī bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho koṇḍañño gottena ahosi.
dn14:1.6.2: sikhī bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho koṇḍañño gottena ahosi.
dn14:1.6.3: vessabhū bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho koṇḍañño gottena ahosi.
dn14:1.6.4: kakusandho bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho kassapo gottena ahosi.
dn14:1.6.5: koṇāgamano bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho kassapo gottena ahosi.
dn14:1.6.6: kassapo bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho kassapo gottena ahosi.
dn14:1.6.7: ahaṃ bhikkhave, etarahi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho gotamo gottena.
dn14:1.7.1: vipassissa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa asīti vassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.
dn14:1.7.2: sikhissa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa sattativassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.
dn14:1.7.3: vessabhussa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa saṭṭhivassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.
dn14:1.7.4: kakusandhassa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa cattālīsavassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.
dn14:1.7.5: koṇāgamanassa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa tiṃsavassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.
dn14:1.7.6: kassapassa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa vīsativassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.
dn14:1.7.7: mayhaṃ bhikkhave, etarahi appakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ yo ciraṃ jīvati so vassasataṃ appaṃ vā bhiyyo.
dn14:1.8.1: vipassī bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho pāṭaliyā mūle abhisambuddho.
dn14:1.8.2: sikhī bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho puṇḍarīkassa mūle abhisambuddho.
dn14:1.8.3: vessabhū bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho sālassa mūle abhisambuddho.
dn14:1.8.4: kakusandho bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho sirīsassa mūle abhisambuddho.
dn14:1.8.5: koṇāgamano bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho udumbarassa mūle abhisambuddho.
dn14:1.8.6: kassapo bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho nigrodhassa mūle abhisambuddho.
dn14:1.8.7: ahaṃ bhikkhave, etarahi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho assatthassa mūle abhisambuddho.
dn14:1.9.1: vipassissa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa khaṇḍatissaṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
dn14:1.9.2: sikhissa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa abhibhūsambhavaṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
dn14:1.9.3: vessabhussa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa soṇuttaraṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
dn14:1.9.4: kakusandhassa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa vidhurasañjīvaṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
dn14:1.9.5: koṇāgamanassa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa bhiyyosuttaraṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
dn14:1.9.6: kassapassa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa tissabhāradvājaṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
dn14:1.9.7: mayhaṃ bhikkhave, etarahi arahato sammāsambuddhassa sāriputtamoggallānaṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ hoti aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
dn14:1.10.1: vipassissa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa tayo sāvakānaṃ sannipātā ahesuṃ. eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi aṭṭhasaṭṭhibhikkhusatasahassaṃ. eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi bhikkhusatasahassaṃ. eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi asītibhikkhusahassāni. vipassissa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa ime tayo sāvakānaṃ sannipātā ahesuṃ sabbesaṃ yeva khīṇāsavānaṃ.
dn14:1.10.2: sikhissa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa tayo sāvakānaṃ sannipātā ahesuṃ: eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi bhikkhusatasahassaṃ. eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi asīti bhikkhusahassāni. eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi sattati bhikkhusahassāni. sikhissa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa ime tayo sāvakānaṃ sannipātā ahesuṃ sabbesaṃ yeva khīṇāsavānaṃ.
dn14:1.10.3: vessabhussa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa tayo sāvakānaṃ sannipātā ahesuṃ: eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi asīti bhikkhusahassāni. eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi sattati bhikkhusahassāni. eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi saṭṭhi bhikkhusahassāni. vessabhussa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa ime tayo sāvakānaṃ sannipātā ahesuṃ sabbesaṃ yeva khīṇāsavānaṃ.
dn14:1.10.4: kakusandhassa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi cattāḷīsa bhikkhusahassāni. kakusandhassa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa ayaṃ eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi sabbesaṃ yeva khīṇāsavānaṃ.
dn14:1.10.5: koṇāgamanassa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi tiṃsabhikkhusahassāni. koṇāgamanassa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa ayaṃ eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi sabbesaṃ yeva khīṇāsavānaṃ.
dn14:1.10.6: kassapassa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi vīsati bhikkhusahassāni. kassapassa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa ayaṃ eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi sabbesaṃ yeva khīṇāsavānaṃ.
dn14:1.10.7: mayhaṃ bhikkhave, etarahi arahato sammāsambuddhassa eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi aḍḍhateḷasāni bhikkhusatāni. mayhaṃ bhikkhave, ayaṃ eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi sabbesaṃ yeva khīṇāsavānaṃ.
dn14:1.11.1: vipassissa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa asoko nāma bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko ahosi aggupaṭṭhāko.
dn14:1.11.2: sikhissa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa khemaṅkaro nāma bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko ahosi aggupaṭṭhāko
dn14:1.11.3: vessabhussa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa upasanto nāma bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko ahosi aggupaṭṭhāko.
dn14:1.11.4: kakusandhassa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa buddhijo nāma bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko ahosi aggupaṭṭhāko.
dn14:1.11.5: koṇāgamanassa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa sotthijo nāma bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko ahosi aggupaṭṭhāko.
dn14:1.11.6: kassapassa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa sabbamitto nāma bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko ahosi aggupaṭṭhāko.
dn14:1.11.7: mayhaṃ bhikkhave, etarahi arahato sammāsambuddhassa ānando bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko hoti aggupaṭṭhāko.
dn14:1.12.1: vipassissa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa bandhumā nāma rājā pitā ahosi.
dn14:1.12.2: bandhumatī nāma devī mātā ahosi janetti.
dn14:1.12.3: bandhumassa rañño bandhumatī nāma nagaraṃ rājadhāni ahosi.
dn14:1.12.4: sikhissa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa aruṇo nāma rājā pitā ahosi.
dn14:1.12.5: pabhāvatī nāma devī mātā ahosi janetti.
dn14:1.12.6: aruṇassa rañño aruṇavatī nāma nagaraṃ rājadhāni ahosi.
dn14:1.12.7: vessabhussa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa suppatīto nāma rājā pitā ahosi.
dn14:1.12.8: yasavatī nāma devī mātā ahosi janetti.
dn14:1.12.9: suppatītassa rañño anomaṃ nāma nagaraṃ rājadhāni ahosi.
dn14:1.12.10: kakusandhassa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa aggidatto nāma brāhmaṇo pitā ahosi.
dn14:1.12.11: visākhā nāma brāhmaṇī mātā ahosi janetti.
dn14:1.12.12: tena kho pana bhikkhave samayena khemo nāma rājā ahosi.
dn14:1.12.13: khemassa rañño khemavatī nāma nagaraṃ rājadhāni ahosi.
dn14:1.12.14: koṇāgamanassa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa yaññadatto nāma brāhmaṇo pitā ahosi.
dn14:1.12.15: uttarā nāma brāhmaṇī mātā ahosi janetti.
dn14:1.12.16: tena kho pana bhikkhave samayena sobho nāma rājā ahosi.
dn14:1.12.17: sobhassa rañño sobhāvatī nāma nagaraṃ rājadhānī ahosi.
dn14:1.12.18: kassapassa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa brahmadatto nāma brāhmaṇo pitā ahosi.
dn14:1.12.19: dhanavatī nāma brāhmaṇī mātā ahosi janetti.
dn14:1.12.20: tena kho pana bhikkhave samayena kikī nāma rājā ahosi.
dn14:1.12.21: kikissa rañño bārāṇasī nāma nagaraṃ rājadhāni ahosi.
dn14:1.12.22: mayhaṃ bhikkhave, etarahi arahato sammāsambuddhassa suddhodano rājā pitā ahosi,
dn14:1.12.26: idaṃ vatvā sugato uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
dn14:1.13.1: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ acirapakkantassa bhagavato ayamantarā kathā udapādi:
dn14:1.13.3: yatra hi nāma tathāgato atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭume pariyādinnavaṭṭe sabbadukkhavītivatte jātitopi anussarissati, nāmatopi anussarissati, gottatopi anussarissati, āyuppamāṇatopi anussarissati, sāvakayugatopi anussarissati, sāvakasannipātatopi anussarissati:
dn14:1.13.4: ‘evaṃjaccā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi, evaṃnāmā evaṃgottā evaṃsīlā evaṃdhammā evaṃpaññā evaṃvihārī evaṃvimuttā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipīti.
dn14:1.13.5: kinnu kho āvuso tathāgatasseva nu kho esā dhammadhātu suppaṭividdhā, yassā dhammadhātuyā suppaṭividdhattā tathāgato atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭume pariyādinnavaṭṭe sabbadukkhavītivatte jātitopi anussarati, nāmatopi anussarati, gottatopi anussarati, āyuppamāṇatopi anussarati, sāvakayugatopi anussarati, sāvakasannipātatopi anussarati: ‘evaṃ jaccā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi, evaṃnāmā evaṃgottā evaṃsīlā evaṃdhammā evaṃpaññā evaṃvihārī evaṃvimuttā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipīti’,
dn14:1.13.6: udāhu devatā tathāgatassa etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ yena tathāgato atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭume pariyādinnavaṭṭe sabbadukkhavītivatte jātitopi anussarati, nāmatopi anussarati, gottatopi anussarati, āyuppamāṇatopi anussarati, sāvakayugatopi anussarati, sāvakasannipātatopi anussarati: ‘evaṃjaccā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi, evaṃnāmā evaṃgottā evaṃsīlā evaṃdhammā evaṃpaññā evaṃvihārī evaṃvimuttā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipīti”
dn14:1.13.7: ayañca hidaṃ tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ antarākathā vippakatā hoti.
dn14:1.14.1: atha kho bhagavā sāyanhasamayaṃ patisallānā vuṭṭhito yena, karerimaṇḍalamāḷo tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
dn14:1.14.3: “kāyanu’ttha bhikkhave etarahi kathāya sannisinnā? kā ca pana vo antarā kathā vippakatā?” ti.
dn14:1.14.4: evaṃ vutte te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
dn14:1.14.5: “idha bhante amhākaṃ acirapakkantassa bhagavato ayamantarā kathā udapādi:
dn14:1.14.6: ‘acchariyaṃ āvuso, abbhutaṃ āvuso tathāgatassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvatā,
dn14:1.14.7: yatra hi nāma tathāgato atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭume pariyādinnavaṭṭe sabbadukkhavītivatte jātitopi anussarissati, nāmatopi anussarissati, gottatopi anussarissati, āyuppamāṇatopi anussarissati, sāvakayugatopi anussarissati, sāvakasannipātatopi anussarissati:
dn14:1.14.8: ‘evaṃjaccā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi, evaṃnāmā, evaṃgottā, evaṃsīlā, evaṃdhammā, evaṃpaññā, evaṃvihārī, evaṃvimuttā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipīti.
dn14:1.14.9: kinnu kho āvuso tathāgatasseva nu kho esā dhammadhātu suppaṭividdhā yassā dhammadhātuyā suppaṭividdhattā tathāgato atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭume pariyādinnavaṭṭe sabbadukkhavītivatte jātitopi anussarati, nāmatopi anussarati, gottatopi anussarati, āyuppamāṇatopi anussarati, sāvakayugatopi anussarati, sāvakasannipātatopi anussarati:
dn14:1.14.10: evaṃjaccā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi, evaṃnāmā, evaṃgottā, evaṃsīlā, evaṃdhammā, evaṃpaññā, evaṃvihārī, evaṃvimuttā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipīti?
dn14:1.14.11: udāhu devatā tathāgatassa etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ yena tathāgato atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭume pariyādinnavaṭṭe sabbadukkhavītivatte jātitopi anussarati, nāmatopi anussarati, gottatopi anussarati, āyuppamāṇatopi anussarati, sāvakayugatopi anussarati, sāvakasannipātatopi anussarati:
dn14:1.14.12: ‘evaṃjaccā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi, evaṃnāmā, evaṃgottā, evaṃsīlā, evaṃdhammā, evaṃpaññā, evaṃvihārī, evaṃvimuttā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipī’ti?
dn14:1.14.13: ayaṃ kho no bhante antarākathā vippakatā hoti. atha bhagavā anuppatto”ti.
dn14:1.15.1: “tathāgatassevesā bhikkhave, dhammadhātu suppaṭividdhā yassā dhammadhātuyā suppaṭividdhattā tathāgato atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭume pariyādinnavaṭṭe sabbadukkhavītivatte jātitopi anussarati, nāmatopi anussarati, gottatopi anussarati, āyuppamāṇatopi anussarati, sāvakayugatopi anussarati, sāvakasannipātatopi anussarati:
dn14:1.15.2: evaṃjaccā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi, evaṃnāmā, evaṃgottā, evaṃsīlā, evaṃdhammā, evaṃpaññā, evaṃvihārī, evaṃvimuttā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipī’ti.
dn14:1.15.4: evaṃjaccā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi, evaṃnāmā, evaṃgottā, evaṃsīlā, evaṃdhammā, evaṃpaññā, evaṃvihārī, evaṃvimuttā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipī’ti.
dn14:1.15.5: iccheyyātha no tumhe bhikkhave, bhiyyosomattāya pubbenivāsapaṭisaṃyuttaṃ dhammiṃ kathaṃ sotunti?”
dn14:1.15.7: yaṃ bhagavā bhiyyosomattāya pubbenivāsapaṭisaṃyuttaṃ dhammiṃ kathaṃ kareyya bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantī”ti.
dn14:1.15.8: “tena hi bhikkhave, suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī”ti.
dn14:1.16.1: “ito so bhikkhave, ekanavuto kappo. yaṃ vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke udapādi.
dn14:1.16.2: vipassī bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho khattiyo jātiyā ahosi, khattiyakule udapādi.
dn14:1.16.3: vipassī bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho koṇḍañño gottena ahosi.
dn14:1.16.4: vipassissa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa asītivassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.
dn14:1.16.5: vipassī bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho pāṭaliyā mūle abhisambuddho.
dn14:1.16.6: vipassissa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa khaṇḍatissaṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
dn14:1.16.7: vipassissa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa tayo sāvakānaṃ sannipātā ahesuṃ:
dn14:1.16.8: eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi aṭṭhasaṭṭhibhikkhusatasahassaṃ. eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi bhikkhusatasahassaṃ. eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi asītibhikkhusatasahassāni.
dn14:1.16.9: vipassissa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa ime tayo sāvakānaṃ sannipātā ahesuṃ sabbesaṃ yeva khīṇāsavānaṃ.
dn14:1.16.10: vipassissa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa asoko nāma bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko ahosi aggupaṭṭhāko.
dn14:1.16.11: vipassissa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa bandhumā nāma rājā pitā ahosi.
dn14:1.16.12: bandhumatī nāma devī mātā ahosi janetti.
dn14:1.16.13: bandhumassa rañño bandhumatī nāma nagaraṃ rājadhāni ahosi.
dn14:1.17.1: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassī bodhisatto tusitā kāyā cavitvā sato sampajāno mātukucchiṃ okkami.
dn14:1.17.3: dhammatā esā bhikkhave, yadā bodhisatto tusitā kāyā cavitvā mātukucchiṃ okkamati,
dn14:1.17.4: atha sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake, sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya appamāṇo uḷāro obhāso pātubhavati atikkammeva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ.
dn14:1.17.5: yā pi tā lokantarikā aghā asaṃvutā andhakārā andhakāratimisā, yatthapime candimasuriyā evaṃmahiddhikā evaṃmahānubhāvā ābhāya nānubhonti, tatthapi appamāṇo uḷāro obhāso pātubhavati atikkammeva devānaṃ devānubhāvā.-
dn14:1.17.6: yepi tattha sattā uppannā, te pi tenobhāsena aññamaññaṃ sañjānanti ‘aññepi kira bho santi sattā idhūpapannā’ti.
dn14:1.17.7: ayañca dasasahassī lokadhātu saṃkampati sampakampati sampavedhati. appamāṇo ca uḷāro obhāso loke pātubhavati atikkammeva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ.
dn14:1.17.9: dhammatā esā bhikkhave, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchiṃ okkanto hoti, cattāro naṃ devaputtā catuddisaṃ rakkhāya upagacchanti: ‘mā naṃ bodhisattaṃ vā bodhisattamātaraṃ vā manusso vā amanusso vā koci vā viheṭhesī’ti.
dn14:1.18.1: dhammatā esā bhikkhave, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchiṃ okkanto hoti, pakatiyā sīlavatī bodhisattamātā hoti viratā pāṇātipātā, viratā adinnādānā, viratā kāmesu micchācārā, viratā musāvādā, viratā surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā.
dn14:1.19.1: dhammatā esā bhikkhave, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchiṃ okkanto hoti, na bodhisattamātu purisesu mānasaṃ uppajjati kāmaguṇūpasaṃhitaṃ. anatikkamanīyā ca bodhisattamātā hoti kenaci purisena rattacittena.
dn14:1.20.1: dhammatā esā bhikkhave, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchiṃ okkanto hoti, lābhinī bodhisattamātā hoti pañcannaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ. sā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitā samaṅgībhūtā paricāreti.
dn14:1.21.1: dhammatā esā bhikkhave, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchiṃ okkanto hoti, na bodhisattamātu kocideva ābādho uppajjati. sukhinī bodhisattamātā hoti akilantakāyā. bodhisattañca bodhisattamātā tirokucchigataṃ passati sabbaṅgapaccaṃ ahīnindriyaṃ.
dn14:1.21.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, maṇi veḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭhaṃso suparikammakato accho vippasanno anāvilo sabbākārasampanno, tatra yaṃ suttaṃ āvutaṃ nīlaṃ vā pītaṃ vā lohitaṃ vā odātaṃ vā paṇḍusuttaṃ vā,
dn14:1.21.3: tamenaṃ cakkhumā puriso hatthe karitvā paccavekkheyya: ayaṃ kho maṇi veḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭhaṃso suparikammakato accho vippasanno sabbākāra sampanno, tatridaṃ suttaṃ āvutaṃ nīlaṃ vā pītaṃ vā lohitaṃ vā odātaṃ vā paṇḍusuttaṃ vā’ti.
dn14:1.21.4: evameva kho bhikkhave yadā bodhisatto mātukucchiṃ okkanto hoti, na bodhisattamātu kocideva ābādho uppajjati, sukhinī bodhisattamātā hoti akilantakāyā. bodhisattañca bodhisattamātā tirokucchigataṃ passati sabbaṅgapaccaṅgiṃ ahīnindriyaṃ.
dn14:1.22.1: dhammatā esā bhikkhave, sattāhajāte bodhisatte bodhisattamātā kālaṃ karoti, tusitaṃ, kāyaṃ upapajjati.
dn14:1.23.1: dhammatā esā bhikkhave, yathā aññā itthikā nava vā dasa vā māse gabbhaṃ kucchinā pariharitvā vijāyanti, na hevaṃ bodhisattaṃ bodhisattamātā vijāyati. daseva māsāni bodhisattaṃ bodhisattamātā kucchinā pariharitvā vijāyati.
dn14:1.24.1: dhammatā esā bhikkhave, yathā aññā itthikā nisinnā vā nipannā vā vijāyanti, na hevaṃ bodhisattaṃ bodhisattamātā vijāyati. ṭhitā’va bodhisattaṃ bodhisattamātā vijāyati.
dn14:1.25.1: dhammatā esā bhikkhave, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchimhā nikkhamati, devā paṭhamaṃ patigaṇhanti, pacchā manussā.
dn14:1.26.1: dhammatā esā bhikkhave, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchimhā nikkhamati, appatto’va bodhisatto paṭhaviṃ hoti. cattāro naṃ devaputtā paṭiggahetvā mātu purato ṭhapenti. ‘attamanā devi hohi mahesakkho. te putto uppanno’ti.
dn14:1.27.1: dhammatā esā bhikkhave, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchimhā nikkhamati, visado’va nikkhamati amakkhito uddena, amakkhito semhena, amakkhito ruhirena, amakkhito kenaci asucinā, suddho visado.
dn14:1.27.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, maṇiratanaṃ kāsike vatthe nikkhittaṃ neva maṇiratanaṃ kāsikaṃ vatthaṃ makkheti, nāpi kāsikaṃ vatthaṃ maṇiratanaṃ makkheti -
dn14:1.27.5: evameva kho bhikkhave yadā bodhisatto mātukucchimhā nikkhamati, visado’va nikkhamati amakkhito uddena, amakkhito semhena, amakkhito ruhirena, amakkhito kenaci asucinā, suddho visado.
dn14:1.28.1: dhammatā esā bhikkhave, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchimhā nikkhamati, dve udakassa dhārā antaḷikkhā pātubhavanti: ekā sītassa ekā uṇhassa, yena bodhisattassa udakakiccaṃ karonti mātucca.
dn14:1.29.1: dhammatā esā bhikkhave, sampatijāto bodhisatto samehi pādehi patiṭṭhahitvā uttarābhimukho satta padavītihāre gacchati setamhi chatte anuhīramāne, sabbā ca disā anuviloketi, āsabhiñca vācambhāsati: “aggo’hamasmi lokassa, jeṭṭho’hamasmi lokassa, seṭṭho’hamasmi lokassa, ayamantimā jāti, natthi’dāni punabbhavo”ti.
dn14:1.30.1: dhammatā esā bhikkhave, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchimhā nikkhamati, atha sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake, sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya appamāṇo uḷāro obhāso pātubhavati, atikkammeva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ.
dn14:1.30.2: yā’pi tā lokantarikā aghā asaṃvutā andhakārā andhakāratimisā, yatthapime candimasuriyā evammahānubhāvā ābhāya nānubhonti, tatthapi appamāṇo uḷāro obhāso pātu bhavati atikkammeva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ.
dn14:1.30.3: ye’pi tattha sattā uppannā, te’pi tenobhāsena aññamaññaṃ sañjānanti: “aññe’pi kira bho santi sattā idhūpapannā”ti.
dn14:1.30.4: ayañca dasasahassī lokadhātu saṃkampati sampakampati sampavedhati. appamāṇo ca uḷāro obhāso loke pātubhavati atikkammeva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ.
dn14:1.31.1: jāte kho pana bhikkhave, vipassimhi kumāre bandhumato rañño paṭivedesuṃ:
dn14:1.31.2: ‘putto te deva jāto: taṃ devo passatū’ti.
dn14:1.31.3: addasā kho bhikkhave bandhumā rājā vipassiṃ kumāraṃ, disvā nemitte brāhmaṇe āmantāpetvā etadavoca: –
dn14:1.31.5: addasaṃsu kho bhikkhave nemittā brāhmaṇā vipassiṃ kumāraṃ disvā bandhumaṃ rājānaṃ etadavocuṃ:
dn14:1.31.6: ‘attamano deva hohi. mahesakkho te deva putto uppanno. lābhā te mahārāja, suladdhaṃ te mahārāja, yassa te kule evarūpo putto uppanno.’
dn14:1.31.7: “ayaṃ hi deva, kumāro dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇehi samannāgato yehi samannāgatassa mahāpurisassa dveva gatiyo bhavanti anaññā -
dn14:1.31.8: sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, rājā hoti cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato.
dn14:1.31.10: seyyathidaṃ – cakkaratanaṃ hatthiratanaṃ assaratanaṃ maṇiratanaṃ itthiratanaṃ gahapatiratanaṃ parināyakaratanameva sattamaṃ.
dn14:1.31.11: parosahassaṃ kho panassa puttā bhavanti sūrā vīraṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā.
dn14:1.31.12: so imaṃ paṭhaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati.
dn14:1.31.13: sace kho pana agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati, arahaṃ hoti sammāsambuddho loke vivattacchado.
dn14:1.32.1: katamehi cāyaṃ deva kumāro dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇehi samannāgato yehi samannāgatassa mahāpurisassa dveva gatiyo bhavanti anaññā-sace
dn14:1.32.2: agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, rājā hoti cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato.
dn14:1.32.4: seyyathidaṃ – cakkaratanaṃ hatthiratanaṃ assaratanaṃ maṇiratanaṃ itthiratanaṃ gahapatiratanaṃ parināyakaratanameva sattamaṃ.
dn14:1.32.5: parosahassaṃ kho panassa puttā bhavanti sūrā vīraṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā.
dn14:1.32.6: so imaṃ paṭhaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati.
dn14:1.32.7: sace kho pana agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati, arahaṃ hoti sammāsambuddho loke vivattacchado. ayaṃ hi deva, kumāro suppatiṭṭhitapādo. yampāyaṃ deva kumāro suppatiṭṭhitapādo, idampimassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
dn14:1.32.8: imassa deva, kumārassa heṭṭhāpādatalesu cakkāni jātāni sahassārāni sanemikāni sanābhikāni sabbākāraparipūrāṇi. yampi deva imassa kumārassa heṭṭhāpādatalesu cakkāni jātāni sahassārāni sanemikāni sanābhikāni sabbākāraparipūrāṇi, idampi’ssa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
dn14:1.32.9: ayaṃ hi deva, kumāro āyatapaṇhī. (yampāyaṃ deva kumāro āyatapaṇhī idampimassa
dn14:1.32.10: mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.) ayaṃ hi deva, kumāro dīghaṅgulī. …pe…
dn14:1.32.15: ayaṃ hi deva, kumāro ṭhitako’va anonamanto ubhohi pāṇitalehi jannukāni parimasati parimajjati …pe…
dn14:1.32.17: ayaṃ hi deva, kumāro suvaṇṇavaṇṇo kañcanasannibhattaco …pe…
dn14:1.32.18: ayaṃ hi deva, kumāro sukhumacchavī. sukhumattā chaviyā rajojallaṃ kāye na upalippati. …pe…
dn14:1.32.19: ayaṃ hi deva, kumāro ekekalomo. ekekāni lomāni lomakūpesu jātāni. …pe…
dn14:1.32.20: ayaṃ hi deva, kumāro uddhaggalomo. uddhaggāni lomāni jātāni nīlāni añjanavaṇṇāni kuṇḍalāvattāni dakkhiṇāvattakajātāni. …pe…
dn14:1.32.25: ayaṃ hi deva, kumāro nigrodhaparimaṇḍalo yāvatakvassa kāyo tāvatakvassa byāmo, yāvatakvassa byāmo tāvatakvassa kāyo. …pe…
dn14:1.32.34: ayaṃ hi deva, kumāro brahmassaro karavīkabhāṇī. …pe…
dn14:1.32.36: ayaṃ hi deva, kumāro gopakhumo. (yampāyaṃ deva kumāro gopakhumo, idampimassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.)
dn14:1.32.37: imassa deva, kumārassa uṇṇā bhamukantare jātā odātā mudutūlasannibhā. yampimassa deva kumārassa uṇṇā bhamukantare jātā odātā mudutūlasannibhā, idampimassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
dn14:1.32.38: ayaṃ hi deva, kumāro uṇhīsasīso. yampāyaṃ deva kumāro uṇhīsasīso, idampimassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
dn14:1.33.1: imehi kho ayaṃ deva, kumāro dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇehi samannāgato yehi samannāgatassa mahāpurisassa dveva gatiyo bhavanti anaññā,
dn14:1.33.2: sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, rājā hoti cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato.
dn14:1.33.4: seyyathidaṃ – cakkaratanaṃ hatthiratanaṃ assaratanaṃ maṇiratanaṃ itthiratanaṃ gahapatiratanaṃ parināyakaratanameva sattamaṃ.
dn14:1.33.5: parosahassaṃ kho panassa puttā bhavanti sūrā vīraṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā.
dn14:1.33.6: so imaṃ paṭhaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati.
dn14:1.33.7: sace kho pana agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati, arahaṃ hoti sammāsambuddho loke vivattacchado”ti.
dn14:1.33.9: atha kho bhikkhave, bandhumā rājā nemitte brāhmaṇe ahatehi vatthehi acchādāpetvā sabbakāmehi santappesi.
dn14:1.34.1: atha kho bhikkhave, bandhumā rājā vipassissa kumārassa dhātiyo upaṭṭhāpesi.
dn14:1.34.2: aññā sudaṃ pāyenti. aññā nahāpenti. aññā dhārenti. aññā aṅkena pariharanti.
dn14:1.34.3: jātassa kho pana bhikkhave, vipassissa kumārassa setacchattaṃ dhārīyittha divā ceva rattiñca
dn14:1.34.4: ‘mā naṃ sītaṃ vā uṇhaṃ vā tiṇaṃ vā rajo vā ussāvo vā bādhayitthā’ti.
dn14:1.34.5: jāto kho pana bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro bahuno janassa piyo ahosi manāpo.
dn14:1.34.6: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, uppalaṃ vā padumaṃ vā puṇḍarīkaṃ vā bahuno janassa piyaṃ manāpaṃ,
dn14:1.34.7: evameva kho bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro bahuno janassa piyo ahosi manāpo.
dn14:1.35.1: jāto kho pana bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro mañjussaro ca ahosi vaggussaro ca madhurassaro ca pemaniyassaro ca.
dn14:1.35.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, himavante pabbate karavīkā nāma sakuṇajāti mañjussarā ca vaggussarā ca madhurassarā ca pemanīyassarā ca,
dn14:1.35.3: evameva kho bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro mañjussaro ca ahosi vaggussaro ca madhurassaro ca pemanīyassaro ca.
dn14:1.36.1: jātassa kho pana bhikkhave, vipassissa kumārassa kammavipākajaṃ dibbaṃ cakkhu pāturahosi, yena sudaṃ samantā yojanaṃ passati divā ceva rattiñca.
dn14:1.37.1: jāto kho pana bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro animisanto pekkhati, seyyathāpi devā tāvatiṃsā.
dn14:1.37.2: ‘animisanto kumāro pekkhatī’ti kho bhikkhave, vipassissa kumārassa ‘vipassī, vipassī’ tveva samaññā udapādi.
dn14:1.37.3: atha kho bhikkhave, bandhumā rājā atthakaraṇe nisinno vipassiṃ kumāraṃ aṅke nisīdāpetvā atthe anusāsati.
dn14:1.37.4: tatra sudaṃ bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro pitu aṅke nisinno viceyya viceyya atthe panayati ñāyena.
dn14:1.37.5: ‘viceyya viceyya kumāro atthe panayati ñāyenā’ti kho bhikkhave, vipassissa kumārassa bhiyyosomattāya ‘vipassī vipassī’ tveva samaññā udapādi.
dn14:1.38.1: atha kho bhikkhave, bandhumā rājā vipassissa kumārassa tayo pāsāde kārāpesi, ekaṃ vassikaṃ ekaṃ hemantikaṃ ekaṃ gimhikaṃ.
dn14:1.38.3: tatra sudaṃ bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro vassike pāsāde vassike cattāro māse nippurisehi tūriyehi paricārayamāno na heṭṭhāpāsādaṃ orohati.
dn14:2.1.1: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro bahunnaṃ vassānaṃ bahunnaṃ vassasatānaṃ bahunnaṃ vassasahassānaṃ accayena sārathiṃ āmantesi:
dn14:2.1.2: ‘yojehi samma sārathi bhaddāni bhaddāni yānāni. uyyānabhūmiṃ gacchāma subhūmiṃ dassanāyā’ti.
dn14:2.1.3: ‘evaṃ devā’ti kho bhikkhave, sārathi vipassissa kumārassa paṭissutvā bhaddāni bhaddāni yānāni yojetvā vipassissa kumārassa paṭivedesi:

dn14:2.17.1: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
dn14:2.17.2: na kho metaṃ patirūpaṃ yo’haṃ ākiṇṇo viharāmi, yannūnāhaṃ eko gaṇamhā vūpakaṭṭho vihareyyanti’.
dn14:2.17.3: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassī bodhisatto aparena samayena eko gaṇamhā vūpakaṭṭho vihāsi. aññeneva tāni caturāsītipabbajitasahassāni agamaṃsu, aññena vipassī bodhisatto.
dn14:2.18.1: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa vāsūpagatassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
dn14:2.18.2: “kicchaṃ vatāyaṃ loko āpanno, jāyati ca jīyati ca mīyati ca cavati ca upapajjati ca. atha ca panimassa dukkhassa nissaraṇaṃ nappajānāti jarāmaraṇassa.
dn14:2.18.3: kudassu nāma imassa dukkhassa nissaraṇaṃ paññāyissati jarāmaraṇassā?ti.
dn14:2.18.4: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
dn14:2.18.5: “kimhi nu kho sati jarāmaraṇaṃ hoti, kimpaccayā jarāmaraṇa’nti.
dn14:2.18.6: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo
dn14:2.18.7: “jātiyā kho sati jarāmaraṇaṃ hoti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇa”nti.
dn14:2.18.8: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
dn14:2.18.9: “kimhi nu kho sati jāti hoti, kimpaccayā jātī”ti.
dn14:2.18.10: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.18.11: “bhave kho sati jāti hoti, bhavapaccayā jātī”ti.
dn14:2.18.12: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
dn14:2.18.13: “kimhi nu kho sati bhavo hoti, kimpaccayā bhavo”ti.
dn14:2.18.14: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.18.15: “upādāne kho sati bhavo hoti, upādānapaccayā bhavo”ti.
dn14:2.18.16: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
dn14:2.18.17: “kimhi nu kho sati upādānaṃ hoti, kimpaccayā upādānanti.”
dn14:2.18.18: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.18.19: “taṇhāya kho sati upādānaṃ hoti, taṇhāpaccayā upādānanti.”
dn14:2.18.20: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
dn14:2.18.21: “kimhi nu kho sati taṇhā hoti, kimpaccayā taṇhā”ti.
dn14:2.18.22: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.18.23: “vedanāya kho sati taṇhā hoti, vedanāpaccayā taṇhā”ti.
dn14:2.18.24: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
dn14:2.18.25: “kimhi nu kho sati vedanā hoti, kimpaccayā vedanā”ti.
dn14:2.18.26: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.18.27: “phasse kho sati vedanā hoti, phassapaccayā vedanā”ti.
dn14:2.18.28: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
dn14:2.18.29: “kimhi nu kho sati phasso hoti, kimpaccayā phasso”ti.
dn14:2.18.30: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.18.31: “saḷāyatane kho sati phasso hoti, saḷāyatanapaccayā phasso”ti.
dn14:2.18.32: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
dn14:2.18.33: “kimhi nu kho sati saḷāyatanaṃ hoti, kimpaccayā saḷāyatananti”
dn14:2.18.34: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.18.35: “nāmarūpe kho sati saḷāyatanaṃ hoti, nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatananti.”
dn14:2.18.36: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
dn14:2.18.37: “kimhi nu kho sati nāmarūpaṃ hoti, kimpaccayā nāmarūpanti”
dn14:2.18.38: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.18.39: “viññāṇe kho sati nāmarūpaṃ hoti, viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpanti.”
dn14:2.18.40: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
dn14:2.18.41: “kimhi nu kho sati viññāṇaṃ hoti, kimpaccayā viññāṇanti”
dn14:2.18.42: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.18.43: “nāmarūpe kho sati viññāṇaṃ hoti, nāmarūpapaccayā viññāṇanti.”
dn14:2.19.1: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
dn14:2.19.2: “paccudāvattati kho idaṃ viññāṇaṃ, nāmarūpamhā nāparaṃ gacchati.
dn14:2.19.3: ettāvatā jāyetha vā jīyetha vā miyyetha vā cavetha vā upapajjetha vā, yadidaṃ
dn14:2.19.4: nāmarūpapaccayā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatanapaccayā phasso, phassapaccayā vedanā, vedanāpaccayā taṇhā, taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ, upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā sambhavanti.
dn14:2.19.6: ‘samudayo, samudayo’ti kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi, ñāṇaṃ udapādi, paññā udapādi, vijjā udapādi, āloko udapādi.
dn14:2.20.1: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
dn14:2.20.2: “kimhi nu kho asati jarāmaraṇaṃ na hoti, kissa nirodhā jarāmaraṇanirodho”ti.
dn14:2.20.3: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.20.4: “jātiyā kho asati jarāmaraṇaṃ na hoti, jātinirodhā jarāmaraṇanirodho”ti.
dn14:2.20.5: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
dn14:2.20.6: “kimhi nu kho asati jāti na hoti, kissa nirodhā jātinirodho”ti.
dn14:2.20.7: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.20.8: “bhave kho asati jāti na hoti, bhavanirodhā jātinirodho”ti.
dn14:2.20.9: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
dn14:2.20.10: “kimhi nu kho asati bhavo na hoti, kissa nirodhā bhavanirodho”ti.
dn14:2.20.11: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.20.12: “upādāne kho asati bhavo na hoti, upādānanirodhā bhavanirodho’ti.
dn14:2.20.13: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
dn14:2.20.14: “kimhi nu kho asati upādānaṃ na hoti, kissa nirodhā upādānanirodho”ti.
dn14:2.20.15: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.20.16: “taṇhāya kho asati upādānaṃ na hoti, taṇhānirodhā upādānanirodho”ti.
dn14:2.20.17: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
dn14:2.20.18: “kimhi nu kho asati taṇhā na hoti, kissa nirodhā taṇhānirodho”ti.
dn14:2.20.19: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.20.20: “vedanāya kho asati taṇhā na hoti, vedanānirodhā taṇhānirodho”ti.
dn14:2.20.21: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
dn14:2.20.22: “kimhi nu kho asati vedanā na hoti, kissa nirodhā vedanānirodho”ti.
dn14:2.20.23: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.20.24: “phasse kho asati vedanā na hoti, phassanirodhā vedanānirodho”ti.
dn14:2.20.25: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
dn14:2.20.26: “kimhi nu kho asati phasso na hoti, kissa nirodhā phassanirodho”ti.
dn14:2.20.27: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.20.28: “saḷāyatane kho asati phasso na hoti, saḷāyatananirodhā phassanirodho”ti.
dn14:2.20.29: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
dn14:2.20.30: “kimhi nu kho asati saḷāyatanaṃ na hoti, kissa nirodhā saḷāyatananirodho?”ti.
dn14:2.20.31: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.20.32: “nāmarūpe kho asati saḷāyatanaṃ na hoti, nāmarūpanirodhā saḷāyatananirodho”ti.
dn14:2.20.33: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
dn14:2.20.34: “kimhi nu kho asati nāmarūpaṃ na hoti, kissa nirodhā nāmarūpanirodho?”ti.
dn14:2.20.35: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.20.36: “viññāṇe kho asati nāmarūpaṃ na hoti, viññāṇanirodhā nāmarūpanirodho”ti.
dn14:2.20.37: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
dn14:2.20.38: “kimhi nu kho asati viññāṇaṃ na hoti, kissa nirodhā viññāṇanirodho?”ti.
dn14:2.20.39: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.20.40: “nāmarūpe kho asati viññāṇaṃ na hoti. nāmarūpanirodhā viññāṇanirodho”ti.
dn14:2.21.1: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi:
dn14:2.21.3: nāmarūpanirodhāya viññāṇanirodho, viññāṇanirodhā nāmarūpanirodho, nāmarūpanirodhā saḷāyatananirodho, saḷāyatananirodhā phassanirodho, phassanirodhā vedanānirodho, vedanānirodhā taṇhānirodho, taṇhānirodhā upādānanirodho, upādānanirodhā bhavanirodho, bhavanirodhā jātinirodho, jātinirodhā jarāmaraṇaṃsokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā nirujjhanti.
dn14:2.21.5: “nirodho, nirodho”ti kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi, ñāṇaṃ udapādi, paññā udapādi, vijjā udapādi, āloko udapādi:
dn14:2.22.1: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassī bodhisatto aparena samayena pañcasūpādānakkhandhesu udayabbayānupassī vihāsi:
dn14:2.22.2: “iti rūpaṃ, iti rūpassa samudayo, iti rūpassa atthaṅgamo.
dn14:2.22.3: iti vedanā, iti vedanāya samudayo, iti vedanāya atthaṅgamo.
dn14:2.22.4: iti saññā, iti saññāya samudayo, iti saññāya atthaṅgamo.
dn14:2.22.5: iti saṅkhārā, iti saṅkhārānaṃ samudayo, iti saṅkhārānaṃ atthaṅgamo.
dn14:2.22.6: iti viññāṇaṃ, iti viññāṇassa samudayo, iti viññāṇassa atthaṅgamo”ti.
dn14:2.22.7: tassa pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu udayabbayānupassino viharato na cirasseva anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccī”ti.
dn14:3.1.1: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa etadahosi:
dn14:3.1.3: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa etadahosi:
dn14:3.1.4: “adhigato kho myāyaṃ dhammo gambhīro duddaso duranubodho santo paṇīto atakkāvacaro nipuṇo paṇḍitavedanīyo.
dn14:3.1.5: ālayārāmā kho panāyaṃ pajā ālayaratā ālayasammuditā.
dn14:3.1.6: ālayārāmāya kho pana pajāya ālayaratāya ālayasammuditāya duddasaṃ idaṃ ṭhānaṃ yadidaṃ idappaccayatāpaṭiccasamuppādo.
dn14:3.1.7: idampi kho ṭhānaṃ duddasaṃ yadidaṃ sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ.
dn14:3.1.8: ahañce va kho pana dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ, pare ca me na ājāneyyuṃ. so mamassa kilamatho, sā mamassa vihesā’ti.
dn14:3.2.1: apissudaṃ bhikkhave, vipassiṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ imā anacchariyā gāthāyo paṭibhaṃsu pubbe assutapubbā:
dn14:3.2.10: itiha bhikkhave, vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa paṭisaṃcikkhato appossukkatāya cittaṃ nami, no dhammadesanāya.
dn14:3.2.11: atha kho bhikkhave, aññatarassa mahābrahmuno vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya etadahosi:
dn14:3.2.12: “nassati vata bho loko, vinassati vata bho loko, yatra hi nāma vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa appossukkatāya cittaṃ namati no dhammadesanāyā”ti.
dn14:3.2.13: atha kho so bhikkhave, mahābrahmā seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evameva brahmaloke antarahito vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa purato pāturahosi.
dn14:3.3.1: atha kho so bhikkhave, mahābrahmā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā dakkhiṇaṃ jāṇumaṇḍalaṃ puthuviyaṃ nihantvā, yena vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā vipassiṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ etadavoca:
dn14:3.3.2: “desetu bhante bhagavā dhammaṃ, desetu sugato dhammaṃ.
dn14:3.3.3: santi sattā apparajakkhajātikā. assavanatā dhammassa parihāyanti.
dn14:3.4.1: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho taṃ mahābrahmānaṃ etadavoca:
dn14:3.4.5: ‘adhigato kho myāyaṃ dhammo gambhīro duddaso duranubodho santo paṇīto atakkāvacaro nipuṇo paṇḍitavedanīyo.
dn14:3.4.6: ālayārāmā kho panāyaṃ pajā ālayaratā ālayasammuditā.
dn14:3.4.7: ālayārāmāya kho pana pajāya ālayaratāya ālayasammuditāya duddasaṃ idaṃ ṭhānaṃ yadidaṃ idappaccayatāpaṭiccasamuppādo.
dn14:3.4.8: idampi kho ṭhānaṃ duddasaṃ yadidaṃ sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ.
dn14:3.4.9: ahañceva kho pana dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ, pare ca me na ājāneyyuṃ, so mamassa kilamatho, sā mamassa vihesā”ti.
dn14:3.4.10: apissudaṃ maṃ brahme, imā anacchariyā gāthāyo paṭibhaṃsu pubbe assutapubbā:
dn14:3.4.19: itiha me brahme paṭisaṃcikkhato appossukkatāya cittaṃ nami, no dhammadesanāyā’ti.
dn14:3.5.2: tatiyampi kho bhikkhave, so mahābrahmā vipassiṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ etadavoca:
dn14:3.5.3: “desetu bhante bhagavā dhammaṃ, desetu sugato dhammaṃ, santi sattā apparajakkhajātikā. assavaṇatā dhammassa parihāyanti. bhavissanti dhammassa aññātāro”ti.
dn14:3.6.1: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho brahmuno ca ajjhesanaṃ viditvā sattesu ca kāruññataṃ paṭicca buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ volokesi.
dn14:3.6.2: addasā kho bhikkhave, vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ volokento satte apparajakkhe mahārajakkhe tikkhindriye mudindriye svākāre dvākāre suviññāpaye duviññāpaye appekacce paralokavajjabhayadassāvino viharante, appekacce na paralokavajjabhayadassāvino viharante.
dn14:3.6.3: seyyathāpi nāma uppaliniyaṃ vā paduminiyaṃ vā puṇḍarīkiniyaṃ vā appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaddhāni udakānuggatāni antonimuggaposīni, appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udakena jātāni udake saṃvaddhāni samodakaṃ ṭhitāni, appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaddhāni udakā accuggamma tiṭṭhanti anupalittāni udakena,
dn14:3.6.4: evameva kho bhikkhave, vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ volokento addasa satte apparajakkhe mahārajakkhe tikkhindriye mudindriye svākāre dvākāre suviññāpaye duviññāpaye, appekacce paralokavajjabhayadassāvino viharante, appekacce na paralokavajjabhayadassāvino viharante.
dn14:3.7.1: atha kho so bhikkhave, mahābrahmā vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya vipassiṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi:
dn14:3.7.12: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho taṃ mahābrahmānaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi:
dn14:3.7.17: atha kho so bhikkhave, mahābrahmā “katāvakāso kho’mhi vipassinā bhagavatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena dhammadesanāyā”ti vipassiṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyi.
dn14:3.8.1: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa etadahosi:
dn14:3.8.2: “kassa nu kho ahaṃ paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ,
dn14:3.8.4: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa etadahosi:
dn14:3.8.5: “ayaṃ kho khaṇḍo ca rājaputto tisso ca purohitaputto bandhumatiyā rājadhāniyā paṭivasanti paṇḍitā viyattā medhāvino dīgharattaṃ apparajakkhajātikā.
dn14:3.8.6: yannūnāhaṃ khaṇḍassa ca rājaputtassa, tissassa ca purohitaputtassa paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ. te imaṃ dhammaṃ khippameva ājānissantī”ti.
dn14:3.9.1: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evameva bodhirukkhamūle antarahito bandhumatiyā rājadhāniyā kheme migadāye pāturahosi.
dn14:3.9.2: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho dāyapālaṃ āmantesi:
dn14:3.9.3: “ehi tvaṃ samma dāyapāla, bandhumatiṃ rājadhāniṃ pavisitvā khaṇḍañca rājaputtaṃ tissañca purohitaputtaṃ evaṃ vadehi:
dn14:3.9.4: “vipassī bhante bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho bandhumatiṃ rājadhāniṃ anuppatto kheme migadāye viharati. so tumhākaṃ dassanakāmo”ti.
dn14:3.9.5: evaṃ bhante’ti kho bhikkhave, dāyapālo vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa paṭissutvā bandhumatiṃ rājadhāniṃ pavisitvā khaṇḍañca rājaputtaṃ tissañca purohitaputtaṃ etadavoca:
dn14:3.9.6: “vipassī bhante bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho bandhumatiṃ rājadhāniṃ anuppatto kheme migadāye viharati, so tumhākaṃ dassanakāmo”ti.
dn14:3.10.1: atha kho bhikkhave, khaṇḍo ca rājaputto tisso cā purohitaputto bhaddāni bhaddāni yānāni yojāpetvā bhaddaṃ yānaṃ abhiruhitvā bhaddehi bhaddehi yānehi bandhumatiyā rājadhāniyā niyyaṃsu, yena khemo migadāyo tena pāyiṃsu.
dn14:3.10.2: yāvatikā yānassa bhūmi yānena gantvā yānā paccorohitvā pattikā’va yena vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā vipassiṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.

dn14:3.11.2: dānakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ, kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ, nekkhamme ca ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.
dn14:3.11.3: yadā te bhagavā aññāsi kallacitte muducitte vinīvaraṇacitte udaggacitte pasannacitte, atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā taṃ pakāsesi:
dn14:3.11.5: seyyathāpi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ sammadeva rajanaṃ patigaṇheyya,
dn14:3.11.6: evameva khaṇḍassa ca rājaputtassa ca tissassa ca purohitaputtassa tasmiṃ yeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi
dn14:3.12.1: te diṭṭhadhammā pattadhammā viditadhammā pariyogāḷhadhammā tiṇṇavicikicchā vigatakathaṃkathā vesārajjappattā aparappaccayā satthusāsane vipassiṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ etadavocuṃ:
dn14:3.12.3: seyyathāpi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya ‘cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintī’ti, evameva bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito,
dn14:3.12.4: ete mayaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāma dhammañca.
dn14:3.12.5: labheyyāma mayaṃ bhante bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyāma upasampadanti”.

dn14:3.14.1: assosi kho bhikkhave, bandhumatiyā rājadhāniyā mahājanakāyo caturāsītipāṇasahassāni
dn14:3.14.2: “vipassī kira bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho bandhumatiṃ rājadhāniṃ anuppatto kheme migadāye viharati.
dn14:3.14.3: khaṇḍo ca kira rājaputto tisso ca purohitaputto vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa santike kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā”ti.
dn14:3.14.5: “na hi nūna so orako dhammavinayo, na sā orakā pabbajjā, yattha kho khaṇḍo ca rājaputto tisso ca purohitaputto kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā.
dn14:3.14.6: khaṇḍo ca nāma rājaputto tisso ca purohitaputto vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa santike kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissanti, kimaṅgapana mayanti.”

dn14:3.15.2: seyyathidaṃ: dānakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ, kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ, nekkhamme ca ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.
dn14:3.15.3: yadā te bhagavā aññāsi kallacitte muducitte vinīvaraṇacitte udaggacitte pasannacitte, atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā taṃ pakāsesi:
dn14:3.15.5: seyyathāpi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ sammadeva rajanaṃ paṭiggaṇheyya.
dn14:3.15.6: evameva tesaṃ caturāsītipāṇasahassānaṃ tasmiṃ yeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi.

dn14:3.16.3: seyyathāpi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya ‘cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintī’ti, evamevaṃ bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
dn14:3.16.4: ete mayaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāma dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
dn14:3.16.5: labheyyāma mayaṃ bhante bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyāma upasampadanti.

dn14:3.18.2: ‘vipassī kira bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho bandhumatiṃ rājadhāniṃ anuppatto kheme migadāye viharati, dhammañca kira desetī’ti.

dn14:3.19.5: seyyathāpi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ sammadeva rajanaṃ paṭiggaṇheyya,

dn14:3.21.1: alatthuṃ kho bhikkhave, tāni caturāsītipabbajitasahassāni vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa santike pabbajjaṃ, alatthuṃ upasampadaṃ.
dn14:3.21.2: te vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
dn14:3.21.3: saṅkhārānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṅkilesaṃ nibbāne ca ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.
dn14:3.21.4: tesaṃ vipassinā bhagavatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena dhammiyā kathāya sandassiyamānānaṃ samādāpiyamānānaṃ samuttejīyamānānaṃ sampahaṃsīyamānānaṃ na cirasseva anupādāya āsavehi cittāni vimucciṃsu.
dn14:3.22.1: tena kho pana bhikkhave, samayena bandhumatiyā rājadhāniyā mahābhikkhusaṅgho paṭivasati aṭṭhasaṭṭhibhikkhusatasahassaṃ.
dn14:3.22.2: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
dn14:3.22.3: “mahā kho etarahi bhikkhusaṅgho bandhumatiyā rājadhāniyā paṭivasati aṭṭhasaṭṭhibhikkhusatasahassaṃ. yannūnāhaṃ bhikkhū anujāneyyaṃ
dn14:3.22.4: ‘caratha bhikkhave, cārikaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya, atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.
dn14:3.22.6: desetha bhikkhave dhammaṃ ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ, kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsetha.
dn14:3.22.7: santi sattā apparajakkhajātikā, assavaṇatā dhammassa parihāyanti,
dn14:3.22.9: api ca channaṃ channaṃ vassānaṃ accayena bandhumatī rājadhāni upasaṅkamitabbā pātimokkhuddesāyā’ti.”
dn14:3.23.1: atha kho bhikkhave, aññataro mahābrahmā vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evameva brahmaloke antarahito vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa purato pāturahosi.
dn14:3.23.2: atha kho so bhikkhave, mahābrahmā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho tenañjalimpanāmetvā vipassiṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ etadavoca:
dn14:3.23.4: mahā kho bhante etarahi bhikkhusaṅgho bandhumatiyā rājadhāniyā paṭivasati aṭṭhasaṭṭhibhikkhusatasahassaṃ. anujānātu bhante bhagavā bhikkhū:
dn14:3.23.5: ‘caratha bhikkhave, cārikaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya, atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.
dn14:3.23.7: desetha bhikkhave, dhammaṃ ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsetha.
dn14:3.23.8: santi sattā apparajakkhajātikā, assavaṇatā dhammassa parihāyanti. bhavissanti dhammassa aññātāro’ti.
dn14:3.23.9: api ca bhante, mayaṃ tathā karissāma yathā bhikkhū channaṃ channaṃ vassānaṃ accayena bandhumatiṃ rājadhāniṃ upasaṅkamissanti pātimokkhuddesāyā”ti.
dn14:3.23.11: idaṃ vatvā vipassiṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyi.
dn14:3.24.1: atha kho bhikkhave, vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho sāyaṇhasamayaṃ patisallānā vuṭṭhito bhikkhū āmantesi:
dn14:3.24.2: idha mayhaṃ bhikkhave, rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
dn14:3.24.3: “mahā kho etarahi bhikkhusaṅgho bandhumatiyā rājadhāniyā paṭivasati aṭṭhasaṭṭhibhikkhusatasahassaṃ.
dn14:3.24.5: “caratha bhikkhave cārikaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya, atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.
dn14:3.24.7: desetha bhikkhave, dhammaṃ ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsetha.
dn14:3.24.8: santi sattā apparajakkhajātikā. assavanatā dhammassa parihāyanti. bhavissanti dhammassa aññātāro.

dn14:3.25.4: maha kho bhante, etarahi bhikkhusaṅgho bandhumatiyā rājadhāniyā paṭivasati aṭṭhasaṭṭhibhikkhusatasahassaṃ.
dn14:3.25.6: “caratha bhikkhave, cārikaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.
dn14:3.25.8: desetha bhikkhave, dhammaṃ ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ, kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsetha.
dn14:3.25.9: santi sattā apparajakkhajātikā, assavaṇatā dhammassa parihāyanti. bhavissanti dhammassa aññātāro.

dn14:3.26.1: “anujānāmi bhikkhave, caratha cārikaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya, atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.

dn14:3.26.7: atha kho bhikkhave, bhikkhū yebhuyyena ekāheneva janapadacārikaṃ pakkamisuṃ.
dn14:3.27.1: tena kho pana bhikkhave, samayena jambudīpe caturāsīti āvāsasahassāni honti.
dn14:3.27.5: pañcannaṃ vassānaṃ accayena bandhumatī rājadhāni upasaṅkamitabbā pātimokkhuddesāyā”ti.
dn14:3.27.6: dvīsu vassesu nikkhantesu devatā saddamanussāvesuṃ: “nikkhantāni kho mārisā dve vassāni, cattāridāni vassāni sesāni. catunnaṃ vassānaṃ accayena bandhumatī rājadhāni upasaṅkamitabbā pātimokkhuddesāyā”ti.
dn14:3.27.7: tīsu vassesu nikkhantesu devatā saddamanussāvesuṃ: “nikkhantāni kho mārisā tīṇi vassāni. tīṇi’dāni vassāni sesāni. tiṇṇaṃ vassānaṃ accayena bandhumatī rājadhāni upasaṅkamitabbā pātimokkhuddesāyā”ti.
dn14:3.27.8: catusu vassesu nikkhantesu devatā saddamanussāvesuṃ: “nikkhantāni kho mārisā cattāri vassāni. dve’dāni vassāni sesāni. dvinnaṃ vassānaṃ accayena bandhumatī rājadhāni upasaṅkamitabbā pātimokkhuddesāyā”ti.
dn14:3.27.12: ekassa vassassa accayena bandhumatī rājadhāni upasaṅkamitabbā pātimokkhuddesāyā”ti.
dn14:3.27.16: atha kho te bhikkhave, bhikkhū appekacce sakena iddhānubhāvena, appekacce devatānaṃ iddhānubhāvena, ekāheneva bandhumatiṃ rājadhāniṃ upasaṅkamiṃsu pātimokkhuddesāya.
dn14:3.28.1: tatra sudaṃ bhikkhave, vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho bhikkhusaṅghe evaṃ pātimokkhaṃ uddisati:
dn14:3.29.1: ekamidāhaṃ bhikkhave, samayaṃ ukkaṭṭhāyaṃ viharāmi subhagavane sālarājamūle.
dn14:3.29.2: tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave, rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
dn14:3.29.3: ‘na kho so sattāvāso sulabharūpo yo mayā anajjhāvutthapubbo iminā dīghena addhunā aññatra suddhāvāsehi devehi.
dn14:3.29.5: atha kho ahaṃ bhikkhave, seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ samiñjeyya, evameva ukkaṭṭhāyaṃ subhagavane sālarājamūle antarahito avihesu devesu pāturahosiṃ.
dn14:3.29.6: tasmiṃ bhikkhave, devanikāye anekāni devatāsahassāni anekāni devatāsatasahassāni yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho bhikkhave, tā devatā maṃ etadavocuṃ:
dn14:3.29.7: “ito so mārisa, ekanavuto kappe yaṃ vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke udapādi.
dn14:3.29.8: vipassī mārisa, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho khattiyo jātiyā ahosi khattiyakule udapādi.
dn14:3.29.9: vipassī mārisa, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho koṇḍaññā gottena ahosi.
dn14:3.29.10: vipassissa mārisa, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa asītivassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.
dn14:3.29.11: vipassī mārisa, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho pāṭaliyā mūle abhisambuddho.
dn14:3.29.12: vipassissa mārisa, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa khaṇḍatissaṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
dn14:3.29.13: vipassissa mārisa, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa tayo sāvakānaṃ sannipātā ahesuṃ: eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi aṭṭhasaṭṭhibhikkhusatasahassaṃ. eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi bhikkhusatasahassaṃ. eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi asītibhikkhusahassāni. vipassissa mārisa, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa ime tayo sāvakānaṃ sannipātā ahesuṃ sabbesaṃyeva khīṇāsavānaṃ.
dn14:3.29.14: vipassissa mārisa, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa asoko nāma bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko ahosi aggupaṭṭhāko.
dn14:3.29.15: vipassissa mārisa, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa bandhumā nāma rājā pitā ahosi.
dn14:3.29.16: bandhumatī nāma devī mātā ahosi janetti.
dn14:3.29.17: bandhumassa rañño bandhumatī nāma nagaraṃ rājadhāni ahosi.
dn14:3.29.18: vipassissa mārisa, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa evaṃ abhinikkhamanaṃ ahosi, evaṃ pabbajjā, evaṃ padhānaṃ evaṃ abhisambodhi, evaṃ dhammacakkappavattanaṃ.
dn14:3.29.19: te mayaṃ mārisa, vipassimhi bhagavatī brahmacariyaṃ caritvā kāmesu kāmacchandaṃ virājetvā idhūpapannā”ti
dn14:3.30.1: tasmiṃ yeva kho bhikkhave, devanikāye anekāni devatāsahassāni anekāni devatāsatasahassāni yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho bhikkhave tā devatā maṃ etadavocuṃ:
dn14:3.30.2: “imasmiṃ yeva kho mārisa, bhaddakappe bhagavā etarahi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke uppanno.
dn14:3.30.3: bhagavā mārisa, khattiyo jātiyā, khattiyakule uppanno.
dn14:3.30.5: bhagavato mārisa, appakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ, yo ciraṃ jīvati so vassasataṃ, appaṃ vā bhiyyo.
dn14:3.30.7: bhagavato mārisa, sāriputtamoggallānaṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
dn14:3.30.8: bhagavato mārisa, eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi aḍḍhateḷasāni bhikkhusatāni. bhagavato mārisa, ayaṃ eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi sabbesaṃyeva khīṇāsavānaṃ.
dn14:3.30.9: bhagavato mārisa, ānando bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko aggupaṭṭhāko.
dn14:3.30.10: bhagavato mārisa, suddhodano nāma rājā pitā,
dn14:3.30.13: bhagavato mārisa, evaṃ abhinikkhamanaṃ ahosi, evaṃ pabbajjā, evaṃ padhānaṃ, evaṃ abhisambodhi, evaṃ dhammacakkappavattanaṃ.
dn14:3.30.14: te mayaṃ mārisa, bhagavatī brahmacariyaṃ caritvā kāmesu kāmacchandaṃ virājetvā idhūpapannā”ti.
dn14:3.31.1: atha khvāhaṃ bhikkhave, avihehi devehi saddhiṃ yena atappā devā tenupasaṅkamiṃ …pe…
dn14:3.31.2: atha khvāhaṃ bhikkhave, avihehi ca devehi atappehi ca devehi saddhiṃ yena sudassā devā tenupasaṅkamiṃ. …pe…
dn14:3.31.3: atha khvāhaṃ bhikkhave, avihehi ca devehi atappehi ca devehi sudassehi ca devehi saddhiṃ yena sudassī devā tenupasaṅkamiṃ. …pe… atha khvāhaṃ bhikkhave, avihehi ca devehi atappehi ca devehi sudassehi ca devehi sudassīhi ca devehi saddhiṃ yena akaniṭṭhā devā tenupasaṅkamiṃ. tasmiṃ bhikkhave, devanikāye anekāni devatāsahassāni anekāni devatā satasahassāni yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho bhikkhave, tā devatā maṃ etadavocuṃ:
dn14:3.31.4: “ito so mārisa, ekanavuto kappo yaṃ vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke udapādi.
dn14:3.31.21: kho bhikkhave, devanikāye anekāni devatāsahassāni anekāni devatāsatasahassāni yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho bhikkhave, tā devatā maṃ etadavocuṃ:
dn14:3.31.22: ito kho mārisa, ekatiṃse kappe yaṃ sikhī bhagavā loke udapādi …pe…
dn14:3.31.23: te mayaṃ mārisa, sikhimhi bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ …pe… idhūpapannā. so yeva kho mārisa, ekatiṃso kappo yaṃ vessabhū bhagavā loke udapādi …pe…
dn14:3.31.24: te mayaṃ mārisa, vessabhumhi bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ caritvā …pe…
dn14:3.31.25: idhūpapannā. imasmiṃ yeva kho mārisa, bhaddekappe kakusandho bhagavā loke udapādi …pe…
dn14:3.31.26: te mayaṃ mārisa, kakusandhamhi bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ caritvā …pe… idhūpapannā. imasmiṃ yeva mārisa, bhaddekappe koṇāgamano bhagavā loke udapādi …pe… te mayaṃ mārisa, koṇāgamanamhi bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ caritvā …pe… idhūpapannā. imasmiṃ yeva mārisa, bhaddakappe kassapo bhagavā loke udapādi …pe… te mayaṃ mārisa, kassapamhi bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ caritvā kāmesu kāmacchandaṃ virājetvā idhūpapanno”ti. tasmiṃ
dn14:3.32.1: yeva kho bhikkhave, devanikāye anekāni devatāsahassāni anekāni devatāsatasahassāni yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho bhikkhave, tā devatā maṃ etadavocuṃ:
dn14:3.32.2: “imasmiṃ yeva kho mārisa, bhaddakappe bhagavā etarahi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke uppanno.
dn14:3.32.15: te mayaṃ mārisa, bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ caritvā kāmesu kāmacchandaṃ virājetvā idhūpapannā”ti.
dn14:3.33.1: iti kho bhikkhave, tathāgatassevesā dhammadhātu suppaṭividdhā yassā dhamma dhātuyā suppaṭividdhattā tathāgato atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭume pariyādinnavaṭṭe, sabbadukkhavītivatte jātitopi anussarati, nāmatopi anussarati, gottatopi anussarati, āyuppamāṇatopi anussarati, sāvakayugatopi anussarati, sāvakasannipātatopi anussarati “evaṃjaccā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi,
dn14:3.33.2: evaṃnāmā, evaṃgottā, evaṃsīlā, evaṃdhammā, evaṃpaññā, evaṃvihārī, evaṃvimuttā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipī”ti.
dn14:3.33.3: devatā’pi tathāgatassa etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ yena tathāgato atīte buddhe parinibbuto …pe… anussarati …pe…
dn14:3.33.6: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
